source: Brydges, Elben, Jurcevic, Vermersch, Maier, Lanyon, Zoller, Blatt, Roos — "Probing Rényi entanglement entropy via randomized measurements", Science 364, 260 (2019)

zenodo.note: The record page's own UI shows a 'v2' label; the record API response captured here (zenodo-record.json) has no metadata.version field -- 'v2' likely reflects Zenodo's versioned-deposit display convention (conceptrecid groups versions; revision=5 is this snapshot's own edit count), not something this API payload exposes directly. Not blocking: the file checksum, license, and content are independently verified below regardless of version label.

retrieval.method: GitHub Actions CI runner fetch (local sandbox egress to zenodo.org is blocked at the proxy/policy level, confirmed directly via curl 403 on CONNECT and via the agent-side WebFetch tool returning EGRESS_BLOCKED for the same host)
jobs: qe4-brydges-pin-measured-states (matrix, run 34718557559) -- one job per raw MeasuredStates file
retrieval.readBackMethod: Each job printed its file's full byte content plus a SHA-256 header into its own CI job log; content was read back via the GitHub Actions job-logs API and every byte verified against the printed hash before being committed here.

files.description: Raw randomized-measurement outcomes (decimal-encoded 10-bit projective measurement, 0-1023), 10-ion clean chain, t=0ms after quench.

Raw randomized-measurement outcomes, 10-ion chain WITH disorder, t=1ms. Rows grouped in blocks of 10 (one disorder realization per block) per Data_Description_10Ions_withDisorder.docx.
Published S2 for half (5-ion) and full (10-ion) subsystems -- P4 reference only.
Single-qubit Bloch-vector components (Sx,Sy,Sz), already averaged per random unitary, for a state DELIBERATELY prepared pure.
Same as PureState.csv but for a state DELIBERATELY prepared mixed.
Raw response of https://zenodo.org/api/records/2527010 at retrieval time -- source of the license/DOI/checksum facts above.

excludedFromScope.20Ions_CleanSystem/*: Fig.3 data for a 20-ion chain. Not used by any of P1-P4 as preregistered (P1/P4 use the 10-ion clean set; P2 uses the 10-ion disorder set). Excluded by scope decided before any file in this folder was opened, not after seeing any result.
excludedFromScope.10Ions_withDisorder/RenyiMutInfo_*.csv,: Rényi mutual-information and author-simulated (Numerics) reference curves -- outside P1-P4's scope, and RenyiMutInfo/Numerics files are explicitly excluded from ever being used as a prediction input, per the preregistration.
